title: Weightlessness Can Cost 30% Of Hip Bone Density
hook: An unprotected Mars mission could cost 30% of hip density.
closing: Floating removes everyday loading, making bone protection essential for surviving long missions.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can fall 1.5 percent monthly, weakening structure even though the bone does not disappear.
Hip density can fall 2.2 percent monthly, showing weight-bearing bones suffer most without gravity.
Unprotected Mars travel projects 30 percent hip-density loss, making prevention part of mission survival.
